title: 第1章 春梦误人真要命第2章 非常斯哈的半兽人
slug: 共梦后被顶级凶兽们亲哭了
lines: “你来了。”男人的声音从身后的传来，直往耳朵里钻，把苏芽芽吓了一个哆嗦，本能想跑开，肩头被人扳住，整个人就被男人正面摁在了怀里。
一股很独特的冷香扑鼻而来。
苏芽芽想看清他的脸，可是眼前的一切还是模模糊糊，根本看不清男人的长相。
“跑什么？嗯？”男人的声音极其动听，带着勾人的尾音卷得人腿发软。
不容她想别的，他那炽热的呼吸喷洒在她的颈间，顺着衣领就往下烫到了心口。
苏芽芽连开口的机会都没有，下一秒被男人堵住了嘴。
温热柔软的触感，只会让她毛骨悚然。
可是她根本挣脱不开，男人紧箍住她的腰身不容她逃走。
她能感觉到男人的手指从上衣的边缘探了进去，碰到了她怕痒的腰。
可是她不自觉的瑟缩被男人认作是躲避，立刻换来男人更为激烈的探索。
苏芽芽猛地从梦里惊醒，额头上都是潮汗。
就连后腰和大腿上，似乎还停留着梦中那男人摩挲过的触感。
她是个成年人，偶尔做个春梦倒也没什么可怕的。
但是每个梦都是在这同一个地方，和同一个男人，甚至情节连续。
这种诡异让她呼吸急促，喘息了好一会，才调整过来。
她看向光脑，才凌晨三点多。
距离斗兽场要求的九点半到岗还有很长时间。
而她昨天忙到了将近十一点，才把负责区域的血迹冲洗干净，现在还很困。
浑身累瘫的她，重新躺下，缓了几次呼吸，又睡着了。
膝盖传来柔软的触感，她为什么会跪在一张大床上？！
“刚刚你去哪了？”身后的白雾中传来男人越来越近的脚步声。
天啊！救命啊！
苏芽芽赶紧往前爬！
身后的脚步声突然加快，她的脚踝被人抓住，往后一拖。
她来不及惊呼，就被滚烫的男人从背后整个压进了柔软的床榻。
“不要！”不知道为什么她在梦里连话都说不清楚，所有声音发出来全是呜呜呜。
“哭什么？”男人的手从她小腹处抄起。
将她整个人密密实实地抱在怀里，半点缝隙也不留。
胡说，她可没哭！
苏芽芽无暇辩驳，只顾得上用力抓着床单，想逃出这个男人的压制：“放开我！你是谁啊？！”
“你真的很不乖，”男人单手撩起她的上衣边缘，“嗯？”
后腰的肌肤裸露在冰凉的空气中，让苏芽芽忍不住挺起腰，想避开这种冷意。
下一秒，火热的气息从腰际传来，在她惊慌失措中，男人在她后腰上咬了一口！
一阵难以忽略的酥麻从脊柱传来，苏芽芽的手也使不上力气，男人将她翻了过来，正面压了上去……
这场梦荒诞又疯狂，第二天苏芽芽被闹钟惊醒时，看到时间已经到了八点十五分，吓得她直接从床上弹起来。
这要是迟到了，还得挨管事的鞭子！
她一向有三个闹钟，第一个是七点半的，第二个是八点整的，可是她连自己怎么关掉的它们都不知道。
她脚站到地上，腿就颤抖地发着软。
难不成梦里梦到的，现实的身体也会有对应的生理反应？
她略一感受，身上还真的有些潮湿黏腻！
content_en:
"You're here." The man's voice came from behind and went straight into his ears, making Su Yaya tremble. She wanted to run away, but someone grabbed her shoulders and pressed her whole body into the man's arms.
A very unique cold fragrance hit my nose.
Su Yaya wanted to see his face clearly, but everything in front of her was still blurry, and she couldn't clearly see the man's appearance.
"Why are you running? Huh?" The man's voice was extremely beautiful, with a seductive ending that made people's legs weak.
She was not allowed to think about anything else. His hot breath sprayed on her neck, running down her collar and burning her heart.
Su Yaya didn't even have a chance to speak, and the next second she was gagged by the man.
The warm and soft touch only made her hair stand on end.
But she couldn't break away at all, and the man held her waist tightly, preventing her from escaping.
She could feel the man's fingers digging in from the edge of her top and touching her ticklish waist.
However, her unconscious shrinking was regarded as avoidance by the man, which immediately led to his more intense exploration.
Su Yaya suddenly woke up from her dream, with sweat on her forehead.
Even on the lower back and thighs, there seemed to be still the touch that the man had rubbed in the dream.
She is an adult, and there is nothing terrible about having an erotic dream once in a while.
But every dream is in the same place, with the same man, and even the plots are continuous.
This weirdness made her breathe quickly, and she took a long breath before she adjusted.
She looked at Guang Nao and saw that it was only around three in the morning.
It was still a long time before the 9:30 required to arrive at the Colosseum.
And she was busy until nearly eleven yesterday to wash away the blood in the area she was responsible for, and she was still very sleepy now.
Feeling exhausted and paralyzed, she lay down again, breathed a few times, and fell asleep again.
There was a soft touch on her knees. Why was she kneeling on a big bed? !
"Where were you just now?" The sound of the man's footsteps getting closer and closer came from the white mist behind him.
Oh my God! Help!
Su Yaya climbed forward quickly!
The footsteps behind her suddenly accelerated, and someone grabbed her ankle and dragged her back.
Before she could exclaim, the hot man pressed her into the soft bed from behind.
"No!" She didn't know why she couldn't even speak clearly in her dream, and all the sounds she made were whining.
"Why are you crying?" The man's hand lifted from her lower abdomen.
He held her whole body tightly in his arms, leaving no gaps.
Nonsense, she didn't cry!
Su Yaya had no time to argue, she could only grasp the sheets hard, trying to escape from this man's oppression: "Let me go! Who are you?!"
"You are really naughty," the man lifted up the edge of her top with one hand, "Huh?"
The skin of her lower back was exposed to the cold air, and Su Yaya couldn't help but straighten her waist to avoid the coldness.
The next second, hot breath came from her waist. When she was panicking, the man bit her on the lower back!
A numbness that was hard to ignore came from the spine, and Su Yaya's hands couldn't use any strength. The man turned her over and pressed her forward...
This dream was absurd and crazy. When Su Yaya woke up from the alarm clock the next day, she saw that the time had reached 8:15, and she was so frightened that she jumped out of bed.
If you are late, you will be whipped by the steward!
She always had three alarm clocks, the first one was for half past seven and the second one was for eight o'clock sharp, but she didn't even know how to turn them off.
When she stood on the ground, her legs were trembling and weak.
Is it possible that what is dreamed in a dream will have corresponding physiological reactions in the real body?
She felt it for a moment and found that her body was really wet and sticky!
